rationale: Only pass environment variables whose names are in both plan.environment_names and policy.environment_allowlist. Add PATH and platform essentials only.
Use concurrent stdout/stderr reads to avoid deadlock, then apply bounded final-assembly redaction and truncation.
Deterministic CI proves lifecycle behavior through injected process and cleanup ports without launching a real OS process.
Recompute HEAD, tree, staged diff, unstaged diff, and untracked-state digest before process creation. This narrows repository TOCTOU but does not claim kernel isolation.
Fake and dry-run plans must remain structurally incapable of real execution. Live authority is a one-time integrity-protected transition bound to plan and complete repository snapshot.
Reservation before process creation prevents concurrent replay. A failed process start remains a consumed process-attempt boundary and cannot be silently replayed.
Preserve deterministic failure-injection compatibility while ensuring every real process goes through the typed secure service and authoritative store.
CI proves contracts and injected lifecycle behavior, but Windows host process-tree cleanup and harmless live execution remain explicit manual evidence gates.
